firewall.why: A host firewall decides which ports the outside world can reach. Without one, every port a process opens is exposed.
firewall.ifIgnored: Nothing breaks today, but a mistake in any container could expose a database or admin port to the internet.

backup.why: The control plane database holds your apps, secrets and settings. A backup is the only way to rebuild after losing this disk.
backup.ifIgnored: If this server's disk fails, every app definition and secret on it is gone and cannot be recovered.

port.why: The ingress needs this port to receive traffic. Something else on this host has it.
port.ifIgnored: Apps will deploy but visitors will reach the other process, not your app.

reachability.why: From the internet, port {{port}} did not answer. Visitors and the certificate authority both need it.
reachability.ifIgnored: Certificates will not issue and public domains will not load. Private use on a local network still works.
reachability.explainer: Check three things in order. First, the cloud firewall or security group for this server must allow inbound TCP {{port}}. Second, the host firewall must allow it too, for example: ufw allow {{port}}/tcp. Third, behind a home router, forward TCP {{port}} to this machine's LAN address.

registry.why: Builds and deploys pull images over HTTPS from this registry, and this host could not reach it.
registry.ifIgnored: Any deploy that needs an image from this registry will fail until it is reachable.

disk.why: Images, build cache and logs all land on this disk. It is running lower than we recommend.
disk.ifIgnored: Builds start failing mid-way and Docker can stop starting containers once the disk is full.

diskLatency.why: Free space does not show how fast the disk writes. Slow writes make deploys and log ingestion feel stuck.
diskLatency.ifIgnored: Everything works, but builds and databases on this disk will be slower than the hardware suggests.
diskLatency.action: See how to fix slow disks

capacityLow.why: This server has less CPU or memory than we recommend for running the control plane and apps together.
capacityLow.ifIgnored: Apps may be killed for running out of memory, and builds will compete with running apps.

secrets.why: Secret keys that never rotate widen the damage if one ever leaks.
secrets.ifIgnored: Nothing breaks. A leaked key simply stays valid for longer.

clock.why: Certificates and signed tokens depend on an accurate clock.
clock.ifIgnored: Certificate issuance and login sessions can fail in confusing ways.

publicIp.why: We could not work out this server's public address, so we cannot tell you which DNS record to create.
publicIp.ifIgnored: You can still continue, but you will need to find the address yourself when you add a domain.

hardening.why: Containers run with more privileges than they need unless hardening is enforced, so a compromised app has more room to act on this host.
hardening.ifIgnored: Apps still run. A compromised container can reach more of the host than it should.

agentAdvertise.why: Remote servers dial this address to join the control plane. It is not set, so there is nothing for them to dial.
agentAdvertise.ifIgnored: Single-server setups are unaffected. Adding a second server later will fail with a confusing connection error.

generic.why: This check reported a problem that is worth a look.
generic.ifIgnored: It does not block deploys, but it may cause surprises later.
